author: caleb_gl
body:
I took a look at ocn's player page, and while I don't want Avicus to be ocn (Avicus is the preferred of the two for me), it would be nice to have a specific amount of monument breaks on the player info page. I know that the player page has the amount per month, but that isn't really helpful. I only play Nebula, but I know this can probably be applied to the other areas of Avicus in some way. 

ocn has it set up as an "objectives" tab. For rushers like myself, I'd love to see something like this implemented!
